CheckTitle: Ensure Network Perimeters are Configured in IAM or the Identity Provider
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Identity domain REST API (read-only admin app role, e.g. Audit Administrator + Security Administrator)
Description: Network perimeters restrict sign-in to trusted IP ranges. Upgraded environments configure them in the identity domain and attach them to sign-on policies; otherwise the external IdP must enforce equivalent rules.
Risk: Without location restrictions at sign-in, stolen credentials work from anywhere.
AuditProcedure: Domains > Security > Network perimeters: at least one perimeter with authorised ranges, referenced by sign-on policy rules.
With an external IdP: confirm conditional access restricts sign-in to approved ranges.

Steps: Create a perimeter with approved ranges and reference it in sign-on rules (or configure conditional access in the IdP).
